beats.says: So last week I sat down to make a video about my product

camera.keys: hold → move on "to make" → move on "about"

beats.why: 'make a video' -> the play tile lands under the script word 'video'
beats.gap_check: 0.00-1.95 type only = first beat exception (the camera is travelling the whole time: keys at 1.36 and 2.02 with drift)

beats.says: two hours in I was still dragging clips around a timeline with nothing to show for it
beats.idea: the pain: time burned, nothing landed
beats.why: 'two hours' -> the clock; 'dragging clips around a timeline' -> the timeline with a cursor shuffling a clip
beats.gap_check: clock is on screen from 3.5 to the whip; timeline joins at 6.12. No bare stretch.

beats.says: And I had this thought, what if I stopped editing and just described what I wanted instead?
beats.why: 'thought' -> the two ? panels; 'described' strikes 'stopped editing'; 'instead?' -> the big ?

beats.says: I typed: open with the problem my customers have, then show how the product fixes it in three steps and end on the number that proves it works.

show.as: the editor prompt box; words type on their onsets; chips problem / 3 steps / the number light; build lights at 25.0

type.typed: TYPED[] = the sentence, word by word

beats.why: 'I typed …' -> the words appear inside the product's prompt box as he says them
beats.gap_check: screen present the whole beat. Readable hold: the full sentence sits from 24.9 to the whip at 25.5 + the chips; short, but the typing IS the content here.

beats.says: That was it. A minute later I had a finished video with the captions, the motion, the music, everything already in place.

show.as: small clock under the line, one sweep = a minute

beats.why: 'a minute later' -> the clock sweeps once; 'finished video … captions, motion, music' -> the four cards
beats.gap_check: clock 26.85-28.40, cards from 28.9 (0.5 s gap while the type keeps arriving). Bare 26.12-26.85 = 0.73 s. OK (edit (a) added the clock; kit had 2.8 s of type only)

beats.says: And honestly, it looked better than what I would have made by hand.
beats.why: 'looked' -> the hand tile; 'by hand' -> it presses
beats.gap_check: 34.48-35.40 type only = 0.92 s. OK (edit (b) moved the tile earlier; kit had 2.6 s)

beats.says: That's the whole trick by the way: problem, steps, proof.

show.as: three circles appear on "trick", stretch into pills on problem / steps / proof

beats.why: 'trick' -> the three-step structure; each word fills its pill
beats.gap_check: 38.12-38.72 type only = 0.60 s. OK (edit (c); kit had 2.2 s)

beats.says: Say it like you'd say it to a friend and let the tool build it.
beats.why: 'say it to a friend' -> a message bubble
beats.gap_check: 42.88-43.90 type only = 1.02 s, at the limit. Accepted: the overlay dissolve is still settling until 42.85+. (edit (d); kit had 3.3 s)

beats.says: If you want the editor I used for this, just comment the word tool and I'll send you the link.

show.as: Instagram post (real still), rail, hand taps comment, "tool" types into the composer, Post lights

beats.why: 'comment the word tool' -> the post, the tap, the typed comment
beats.gap_check: post on screen for the whole beat.
